body: Follow-up run, second half (2026-09-27 15:30 to 17:10):U+000AU+000AU+002D Spell check (plain app, real clicks, accessibility off): pass. Misspellings get dotted underlines; the switch persists.U+000AU+002D MB2 NEW, Blocks: the daily reminder never appears on macOS. Set to 15:40 via the Material time picker on a day with no entry; no banner; `plutil -p ~/Library/Preferences/com.apple.ncprefs.plist` lists 114 bundle-ids and none is a Field Notes build, so no build ever reached a notification permission prompt. `lib/features/reminders/reminder_coordinator.dart` cancels silently on permission refusal, so Settings still shows the reminder on. Suspect (unverified): ad-hoc signing (`codesign -dv` shows Signature=adhoc, no TeamIdentifier). The plain app had been closed by the guard at 15:38:58 (owner mouse), but scheduled UN notifications survive app exit and nothing was registered anyway.U+000AU+002D Time picker: Material 12-hour dial while the row shows 24-hour 20:30; typed-entry mode did not accept typed digits reliably.U+000AU+002D Discord's floating "Lobby" call window (layer 3, top right) intercepted clicks; the plain window was narrowed to 1100 px at x=0 to avoid it.U+000AU+002D Real VoiceOver: Quickstart window appears on each start ("Use VoiceOver" pressed via AX); the owner allowed the TCC prompt "Warp wants access to control VoiceOver"; VoiceOver's own "Allow VoiceOver to be controlled with AppleScript" asks for an admin password (SecurityAgent), cancelled with Escape without entering anything. The caption panel (VoiceOver window layer 3000) can be captured by window id and read with Vision OCR (scratchpad ocr), so AppleScript is not needed. The Settings and month-picker VoiceOver reading was NOT run: the owner stayed active through two 10-minute idle waits, and VoiceOver was quit rather than left talking.U+000AU+002D Restored: VoiceOver quit and its universalaccess voiceOverOnOffKey deleted (it did not exist before); input sources back to the original four; Dark appearance; Finder test window closed; keep-awake released. NOT restored: Warp -> VoiceOver automation switch, because switching it off needs Touch ID or the password; System Settings left open at Privacy & Security > Automation for the owner.U+000AU+002D Report updated: verdict now names MB2; follow-up table added with H11 (Pinyin) and MB2.
